gate_passed/list_importers.stdout:
File importers:
  ics          Google Calendar (ICS) (*.ics, *.zip)
               Preview events from ICS calendar files or Google Calendar export ZIP without writing to the journal
  obsidian     Obsidian / Logseq Vault (*.md)
               Preview notes from an Obsidian or Logseq vault without writing to the journal
  claude       Claude Chat History (*.zip, *.dms)
               Preview conversations from Claude chat export without writing to the journal
  chatgpt      ChatGPT History (*.zip)
               Preview conversations from ChatGPT export without writing to the journal
  kindle       Kindle Highlights (*.txt)
               Preview highlights and notes from Kindle's My Clippings.txt without writing to the journal
  gemini       Gemini Activity History (*.zip, *.json)
               Preview activity from Google Takeout Gemini/Bard export without writing to the journal
  document     Documents (*.pdf)
               Import PDF documents with worker-backed text and raster extraction
  image        Image (*.png, *.jpg, *.jpeg, *.webp, *.gif, *.tiff)
               Import a single image and describe its contents with vision
  journal_archive Journal Archive (*.zip)
               Merge an exported journal archive into the current journal
  apple_health Apple Health (apple_health_export/, export.xml, *.zip)
               Preview Apple Health export.xml data without writing to the journal
  oura         Oura (daily_sleep.json, daily_readiness.json, sleep.json)
               Preview Oura API v2 JSON documents (synthetic fixtures; save path is a later, gated phase)
